I started this series because I found myself excitedly checking through [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter?gameId=1303&pk_vid=b8cc2fa761b328a61755051662c71015]Flashshifter[/url]﻿'s Patreon for news of SVE's Castle Village update/sequel mod, and I got the itch to create some castle-themed Stardew art, so here we are! S.O. to Flashshifter, their creativity is catching. I studied their art style and the color palettes from Lance's Highlands Outpost to design the castles.


As always, the flowers on the decorated versions of the buildings are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url]﻿, a gigantic thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts?gameId=1303]HimeTarts[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url]﻿ for their beautiful mods and for making their work available for the community to use.


To everyone who has reached out to share their appreciation for the series 🥹, thank you all!
